parameters.name: BdsId
parameters.description: The ID of the BDS cluster.

parameters.name: HaId
parameters.description: The high-availability ID in BDS high-availability management.

parameters.name: HaTypes
parameters.description:
The high-availability type. Valid values:
1. thrift
2. phoenix.

parameters.name: HbaseType
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to switch to the primary or secondary instance. Valid values:
1. Active: Switch to the primary instance.
2. Standby: Switch to the secondary instance.
